title: Hearty Tunisian Pork Tagine
description: A fresh and juicy Tunisian dish featuring pork in a soffritto base, also suitable for vegan adaptation by substituting the pork, this recipe is full of energizing flavors.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the pork cubes and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, tomato paste, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Stir well to combine, then add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1 1/2 hours.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve with crusty bread or over couscous.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
